name: es.uji.geotec.wearossensors.services.SensorMessagingListenerService
description: When a Wear OS watch sends a message through Google Play services, GeoTecINIT WearOS Sensors receives capability requests and forwards accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, heart-rate, location, and plain messages to the app.
disableEffect: The app will no longer receive sensor readings or messages sent from the watch.
